headline: Low interaction risk overall; no shared channels or write capabilities, but marker can process documents while LightZero is a non-runnable game-playing package.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: LightZero has no filesystem, MCP, browser, or subprocess surfaces, and marker also lacks shared channels or write paths. With no documented bridge between them, there is no plausible default prompt-injection pathway.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator copies marker output into a separate prompt channel for LightZero, injection becomes possible.
mitigations: Keep the agents in separate processes with no shared clipboard.
Do not pipe marker text into any instruction-following agent.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to any cross-agent text handoff.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither agent can read or write the filesystem, and both report network egress as none. LightZero touches no data classes, while marker's profile also shows no touched data classes, so there is no documented leakage path between them.
conditions: IF either agent is later granted filesystem access to shared sensitive files, leakage risk changes.
mitigations: Do not mount a shared workspace.
Review any future permission changes before deployment.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both profiles explicitly lack filesystem write, git mutation, subprocesses, and network egress, so there is no overlapping mutable resource to contend over. The pairwise conflict pathway is blocked by the documented capabilities.
conditions: IF either agent is granted write access to the same directory or repo, conflict risk appears.
mitigations: requires-engineering: add lock coordination before enabling writes.

D_cascading_error.rationale: marker is a document-processing agent, so it could consume LightZero-generated text if an operator manually chains them. But LightZero is a game-playing package with no documented output-to-action authority, and marker has no autonomous downstream action surface here, so the blast radius is limited.
conditions: IF an operator feeds LightZero output into marker as authoritative source text, cascading errors can propagate.
IF marker output is used as a decision input without verification, the risk increases.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step between agents.
Require marker to cite source provenance.
Limit chained use to non-decision drafts.

E_compliance.rationale: No data residency, retention, certification, or regulated data classes are documented for either agent, and both profiles show empty data_classes_touched. With no compliance-sensitive flow identified, there is no pairwise compliance mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF regulated data classes such as PHI or EU PII are introduced into either workflow, compliance review is required.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both agents.
requires-engineering: document residency and retention controls before deployment.
